name: hanbit_demand_market
purpose: Tests whether a quantity change rests only on UK demand (2026-10-25). Three items with the same stock figures and the same kind of document, a demand rise of unstated size since January 2025, differing only in which market the rise is in: not stated (MotorBracket), the UK (CoolingFan), Korea, the supplier's home market (SensorHousing). Expected: MotorBracket keeps its quantity and gets a question on which market; CoolingFan may get a provisional uplift marked as an estimate; SensorHousing keeps its quantity and gets a supply question or action (allocation, lead time, price). No supplier-wide document, so lead times stay at 18 weeks. Not part of the evaluation set.

history.text: Demand for MotorBracket has risen sharply since January 2025 after a popular home-improvement video featured it.
UK demand for CoolingFan has risen sharply since January 2025, after two UK retail chains added it to their ranges.
Demand for SensorHousing in Korea has risen sharply since January 2025, as Korean electronics makers increase production.
